definitions.explanation: A sign posted upright on a board or stake, typically placed outdoors to convey warnings, information, or rules. Historically used by authorities to post official notices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}て{札|ふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a notice board in the park.

examples.japanese: {立|た}て{札|ふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧{立|た}て{札|ふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In front of the old shrine, a signpost explaining its history had been set up.

notes:
USAGE:
{立|た}て{札|ふだ} refers to a physical sign that is posted upright, often made of wood. In historical contexts, authorities posted official decrees on {立|た}て{札|ふだ} at major intersections.
